programme.desc: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

programme.desc: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

programme.desc: Having stolen billions from the populace, Ukrainian dictator Viktor Yanukovych hides his treasure trove in a mind-bending corruption scheme that leads to Mezhyhirya, a 150-acre estate, with secret underground tunnels.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "Jupiter"
programme.desc: This episode examines the work of the Galileo orbiter and the Juno probe that have advanced our deeper understanding of this giant.

programme.desc: Blue World visits the New England Aquarium to learn what it takes to be an aquarist, investigates the spawning behavior of Mandarin fish, and travels to Mexico to find feeding Whale sharks.

programme.title: Blue World S2 - "Mantas, Tropical Fish Rescue and Tiger Sharks"
programme.sub-title: Mantas, Tropical Fish Rescue and Tiger Sharks
programme.desc: Blue World travels to Micronesia to learn about Manta rays, helps rescue tropical fish in New England, and dives with Tiger sharks in the Bahamas.

programme.title: Blue World S2 - "Sea Turtles, Mangroves and Wolffish"
programme.desc: Blue World heads to Malaysia to learn about sea turtles, explore mangroves, and investigate the Wolffish.

programme.sub-title: Diving the Mexican Underground and Venomous Fish

programme.title: Blue World S2 - "Sea Stars, The Real Nemo and Feeding Frenzy"
programme.sub-title: Sea Stars, The Real Nemo and Feeding Frenzy
programme.desc: Blue World learns about sea stars, anemonefish and shark feeding frenzies.

programme.desc: Blue World searches for lobsters in Maine, learns about remoras on sharks, and feeds stingrays in Grand Cayman.

programme.title: Blue World S2 - "Antarctic Adventure"
programme.desc: Blue World travels to Antarctica on an epic adventure where we swim with penguins, meet a Leopard Seal, and dive under icebergs.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage S1 - "City of Dogs"
programme.desc: Anchorage is the start of the World’s Toughest Sled-Dog Race known as the Iditarod. But there’s another canine running wild on these city streets. The urban coyotes cannot resist the Anchorage's sights, smells and constant food supply.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage S1 - "Caribou: Extreme Survivors"
programme.desc: With more Caribou in Alaska than people, they’re the lifeblood of many remote communities. But human expansion, and wild predators, have led to their rapid decline.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage S1 - "City Lynx"
programme.desc: One of Alaska’s most secretive and efficient predators, the Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx’s territory, forcing them to find new ways to survive on the streets.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage S1 - "Bald Eagle Rescue"
programme.desc: As expert hunters, the Bald Eagle is perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival...is trash.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage S1 - "Wolves on Main Street"
programme.desc: For years, at least four wolfpacks have lived and hunted on the edge of Anchorage. But as the city spreads further into wolf country, they are getting bolder, and attacks on humans are increasing.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage S1 - "Bears Behaving Badly"
programme.desc: Hundreds of Black Bears live in Anchorage and have found a food source that is much easier to catch than slippery salmon - it’s trash. Any it's everywhere. With their brains, brawn and cunning these bears have mastered life in the urban jungle.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Bushytails"
programme.desc: If you walk through a forest anywhere in North America, you're likely to hear the scolding chatter of a tree Squirrel. These lively creatures are among our most popular and visible wild animals.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Controversial Coyote"
programme.desc: To some of us,this mournful cry kindles delight and inspiration,to others dread and hatred. In Indian mythology,the coyote was revered for its cleverness and mystical song.Yet our modern society condemns the Coyote for its predatory instinct to kill.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Cottontails And Kin"
programme.desc: The Cottontail is perhaps the most prominent character in American folklore, but bedtime stories hardly reflect the daily struggle for survival of real life Rabbits.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Family of Foxes"
programme.desc: In French, the Fox is called "Reynard", meaning "unconquerable through his cleverness". Is this charming canid as crafty as the fables portray? Does it deserve its reputation as henhouse bandit?

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Just Little Varmints"
programme.desc: From the Arctic Ground Squirrel of Alaska and the Golden-mantled of the Rockies to the ubiquitous Prairie Dog, our concealed cameras shed light on why these under-appreciated little critters allow us all to enjoy Nature's most magnificent species.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Managing Wildlife"
programme.desc: Managing wildlife most often means managing humans -- the primary predator in virtually all our ecosystems. Through this complex, but vital, process, we constantly try to balance our own conflicting interests with those of our native wild creatures.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Old Man Muskrat"
programme.desc: This medium sized rodent lives anywhere it can find plant food and still water. A diligent worker, it's always swimming, digging, or eating. Beady eyed and all business, it can be quarrelsome.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Ringtailed Rascals"
programme.desc: We're fascinated by the Jaguar's spots, the Skunk's stripes, and the Raccoon's mask and Ringtailed. Maybe it's because these characteristic markings enable us to identify them easier and they even add an extra dimension to their personalities.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Wild Turkey Part 1"
programme.desc: A creature chosen by the Pilgrims for the first Thanksgiving meal that's now a rarity in Nature. Our largest gamebird with its flamboyant courtship.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Wild Turkey Part 2"
programme.desc: Part 2 continues to explore the wild turkey as one of game management's greatest success stories. Our traditional symbol of Nature's abundance was once feared to be gone as a gamebird due to overhunting by humans and a loss of their habitat.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Baby Owls S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: In an abandoned WWI airfield in rural Essex lives Missing Claw, Geronimo and Flo. Over the course of winter, spring and early summer, we get a privileged view of their secret lives using a special camera rig outside, and inside their nests.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "ELITE CORPS"
programme.desc: Survival demands an edge. Witness some of the animals whose elite sensory abilities put them at the top of their game.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "NAVY SEALS"
programme.desc: In the water, it takes sophisticated navigation systems, fine-tuned reflexes, and high-precision detection methods to survive. These animals have what it takes.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "PATROL"
programme.desc: Life in the wild is life during wartime, and these animal soldiers have mastered the tactics of surveillance, stealth, and attack.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "SPECIAL GEAR"
programme.desc: On the savannah, in the forest, or under the sea, the competition never quits. Having the right gear provides more than a fighting chance for success.
